name: Length
description: Distance, height, width — anything that measures how long something is. SI base unit: the metre (m).

name: Mass
description: How much matter is in something. Differs from weight (which is force). SI base: kilogram (kg).

name: Temperature
description: How hot or cold something is. Conversions are affine — there is an offset, not just a multiplier.

name: Area
description: Size of a 2-D surface. SI base: square metre (m²).

name: Volume
description: Space occupied by a 3-D object. SI base: litre (L) for everyday use; cubic metre (m³) for SI.

name: Speed
description: Distance per unit time. SI: metre per second (m/s).

name: Data
description: Digital information size. SI: the byte (B). Note the difference between decimal (KB=1000) and binary (KiB=1024) prefixes.

name: Energy
description: Capacity to do work. SI base: joule (J). Also commonly expressed as calories, kWh, BTU.

name: Pressure
description: Force per unit area. SI base: pascal (Pa).

name: Angle
description: Rotation or turning. SI base: radian (rad).

name: Fuel Economy
description: Distance per unit of fuel, or its reciprocal (fuel per distance). Base: litres per 100 km.
